annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite affine-recurrence formalization of Lemma 4.3

assumptions: The propagation matrix B is componentwise nonnegative.
Every source term satisfies abs(d_m)<=s, with s nonnegative.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P08 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p08_t3_componentwise_affine_recurrence {n : Nat} (B : Fin n -> Fin n -> Real) (q d : Nat -> Fin n -> Real) ... : forall m i, abs (q (m+1) i) <= p08MatVec (p08MatPow B (m+1)) (abs (q 0)) i + sum k in range (m+1), p08MatVec (p08MatPow B k) s i
formal_statement.plain_language: A nonnegative componentwise affine residual recurrence is bounded by the exact finite matrix-geometric propagation of its initial value and source budget.

informal_proof: First turn the signed recurrence into an absolute componentwise inequality. Build its nonnegative affine envelope, prove domination by induction, and separately unroll the envelope into the displayed matrix-power sum.
informal_statement: The finite induction certificate at the core of Lemma 4.3's all-iteration residual bound.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 35, issue 151, July 1980, printed pages 817-832

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen baseline supplies only the one-step absolute matrix-action inequality. It has no theorem connecting a signed time-indexed residual recurrence to this componentwise finite matrix-geometric envelope.

source_locations.role: finite componentwise residual recurrence and induction bound

tier_rationale: NumStability.abs_matMulVec_le supplies a useful one-step adapter, but the L proof must newly construct the nonnegative affine envelope, prove absolute-value domination for every iterate, and derive the exact finite matrix-power sum.
